fonts.name: Proto Canaanite (Sarabit al-Kadim inscriptions, ca. 1700 BCE), alternate forms 2
fonts.notes: Extracted from Yoram Gnat’s Proto Canaanite font: every letter’s dagesh-triggered alternate pictograph form, made directly typeable instead of requiring the base+dagesh sequence. The sans-sofit style not applied in order to show the alternative letter forms found there.

fonts.name: Proto Canaanite (Sarabit al-Kadim inscriptions, ca. 1700 BCE), alternate forms 3
fonts.notes: Extracted from Yoram Gnat’s Proto Canaanite font: the 9 letters (dalet, vav, het, kaf, lamed, pe, tsadi, qof, shin) with a rafe-triggered third alternate pictograph form; the other 13 letters show their regular form. The sans-sofit style not applied in order to show the alternative letter forms found there.
